goal: After the one-shot dual-view specialist run failed, separate activation calibration, diffuse soft-edge execution, and endpoint-role residual reasoning before any retraining.

localization.gate: causal-vs-preservation score distributions, AUC, strict rank separation
execution_modes: actual activation + predicted hard top1 binding
forced specialist + predicted hard top1 binding
localization.endpoint_role: relevant-edge source/target proposal preference and within-pair endpoint accuracy

method_lessons: Perfect top1 binding does not imply sparse enough execution when residual mass remains distributed across distractor edges.
A router may be miscalibrated even when expert-vs-parent scores rank inputs correctly; measure separation before changing the gate.
High specialist activation with low task accuracy proves activation is not the only bottleneck.
Endpoint-role reasoning should be measured directly instead of inferred from end-to-end field accuracy.
